resources.name: substances
resources.description: One row per pesticide-domain substance: identifiers, structure checks, ChEBI mapping, PubChem cross-check.

fields.name: substance_uuid
fields.description: IUCLID SUBSTANCE document UUID in OpenFoodTox 3.0

fields.name: efsa_role
fields.description: active_substance (EFSA code PPP) or residue_or_metabolite (PAR), etc.

fields.name: cas
fields.description: CAS Registry Number, normalised

fields.name: cas_valid
fields.description: CAS check digit passes

fields.name: structure_agreement
fields.description: Whether OpenFoodTox InChI and SMILES describe the same molecule

fields.name: inchikey
fields.description: Curated InChIKey, computed with RDKit from the InChI (else SMILES)

fields.name: chebi_id
fields.description: ChEBI identifier (CURIE)

fields.name: chebi_classes
fields.description: Agrochemical classes asserted in ChEBI via has_role (RO:0000087)

resources.name: reference_values
resources.description: Health-based reference values (ADI, ARfD, AOEL, AAOEL, other) in long format with harmonised units.

fields.name: unit_ucum
fields.description: Unit as a UCUM code

fields.description: Value converted to the canonical unit

fields.name: unit_canonical
fields.description: Canonical unit: mg/kg bw/day, mg/kg bw, mg/L or mg/m3

fields.name: uncertainty_factor
fields.description: Overall uncertainty factor applied by EFSA

fields.description: Study record EFSA cites as the critical endpoint

fields.name: quarantined
fields.description: True when an issue makes the row unusable as a number

fields.name: source_doi
fields.description: DOI of the EFSA output(s) the record was published in
